parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse add-ssl-cert --domain-id 0 --cert-identifier 5213641-cn-hangzhou --gateway-unique-id gw-c70622ff52fe49beb29bea9a6f520000 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
